I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It's the 1280px settings screen inside `#component`, with your exact copy and no JavaScript. I read all four files; `DESIGN.md` was the only one with design rules, `session.json` was empty, and `session.err` holds only a model-name error.

- **Design rules:** It uses only the `DESIGN.md` colors, type sizes, spacing and radii. Buttons are pills at least 44px tall, with Title Case labels.
- **Headings:** The page title is Unbounded Light in caps, and each section sits in a white card on a pale-blue page.
- **Switches:** The notification switches are native checkboxes styled as switches, each with its label. I set "Email me when a request is assigned to me" and "Weekly summary" to on, and "Product updates" to off.
- **Danger zone:** The card has an ink border and a quiet outlined "Delete Workspace" button. `DESIGN.md` has no red, so I didn't use one.
- **Fonts:** The Unbounded and Archivo fonts are named in the CSS but not loaded, since no font files were provided. Without them installed, the browser will fall back to a system sans-serif.
